objects.name: The Keeper
lines: Ah, you're on your feet. Good. Slowly, now. Five hundred years is a long sleep.
Walk wherever you like. The Archive is yours as much as mine.
The board on the north wall holds the day's tasks, if you want something to do.
The door? Not yet. When you're stronger, it will open.
